items.title: Labor unveils new powers to strengthen social media ban
items.description: Six months into Australia's world-first social media ban for under-16s, the federal government has announced tougher laws that it says will hold big tech to account and keep kids safe online.

items.title: Iran says it hit US-linked targets as Bahrain reports drone attack
items.description: Also in the Strait of Hormuz an oil tanker has been damaged by an "unidentified projectile", while an Israeli drone has reportedly struck an area of southern Lebanon.

items.title: Daughter of stabbing victims calls for better mobile coverage
items.description: The daughter of an elderly couple attacked in an alleged home invasion in northern NSW wants to see mobile coverage improved across regional areas.

items.title: Australian arrested after teenage girl's body found in a suitcase in Thailand
items.description: An Australian man is in custody after the body of a teenage girl was found in a suitcase in Thailand.

items.title: Panthers coach gives 13-word press conference after consecutive losses
items.description: Penrith Panthers coach Ivan Cleary has said just 13 words in his post-match press conference after the NRL leaders fell to consecutive defeats for the first time this season.

items.title: These billionaires' kids are learning something most Australians are not
items.description: Rich and powerful families have a strong interest in one particular language, with experts saying it is no surprise given the country's rise.

items.title: Butters coy about Power future after starring in upset Showdown win
items.description: Following a masterful display, Zak Butters is awarded the Showdown Medal in what may be his last match for the Power against the Crows.

items.title: In Beirut, a sacred ceremony also becomes display of Hezbollah's force
items.description: Tens of thousands of Shiite Muslims gathered in Beirut for the largest Ashura procession in years, as Hezbollah used the holy day to project strength despite growing pressure to disarm after months of war with Israel.

items.title: Farewell: 27 things Virginia Trioli learned at the ABC
items.description: After almost 40 years in Australian journalism, 27 of them at the ABC, I am now in possession of enough mistakes to claim a small amount of experience.

items.title: Australia's next opponent locked in after World Cup chaos
items.description: The Socceroos will meet Egypt in the knockout stage of the World Cup after a stunning finish in Group G. Follow live.

items.title: President Trump Announces U.S. Military Airstrike in Venezuela
items.description: President Trump states the U.S. military conducted its first known airstrike inside Venezuela targeting a dock where drugs were allegedly loaded onto boats[1][2][4].

items.title: Trump Meets Netanyahu at Mar-a-Lago for Gaza Ceasefire Phase Two Talks
items.description: President Trump met with Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu to discuss advancing phase two of the Gaza ceasefire, including reconstruction and responses to Iran[1][4].

items.title: Feds Launch Massive Taxpayer Fraud Probe in Minnesota After Viral Video
items.description: Federal agencies including DHS, FBI, and ICE investigate $110 million in suspected fraud at Minnesota child care centers following a viral YouTube video[3].

items.title: Americans Express Widespread Opposition to AI Data Centers
items.description: Public backlash against AI infrastructure data centers grows, with protests and demands for bans influencing Democratic Party strategies for future elections[3].

items.title: Elon Musk's Humanoid Robot Vision: China Poised to Lead Production
items.description: China prioritizes humanoid robots in tech race with U.S., ramping up production while warning of industry bubble and potential bottlenecks[3].

items.title: Trump-Putin Call Amid Ukraine-Russia Tensions Over Peace Plan
items.description: President Trump spoke with Putin amid ongoing Ukraine conflict, with Russia reevaluating peace plan tenets after Ukrainian denials[1].

items.title: Democratic Gubernatorial Candidates in Wisconsin Focus on Inflation and Trump
items.description: Seven Democrats vying for Wisconsin governor blame economic issues on Trump and emphasize affordability ahead of 2026 primary[3].
